expected_evidence.description: Target deadline, execution completion, and compensation timing establish overlap.
Target success and active effect coexist with compensated workflow state.
Healthy and legitimately compensated controls distinguish deadline behavior.

ground_truth.explanation: The orchestrator compensated at its deadline while the original execution was still in progress, then that execution succeeded and created an effect.

ground_truth_v2.explanation: The workflow orchestrator transitioned into compensation at the deadline before original execution completed, allowing a later success to coexist with the compensated workflow state.

title: Incident 003 — Inconsistent State from Premature Compensation
troubleshooting_question: One workflow finished with a state that does not agree with its recorded downstream effect. Review the surrounding evidence and identify the most likely root cause.
